events.title: Pediatrician follow-up — Ahmad
events.notes: Mom drives. Bring insurance card and the yellow forms Dad filled out. Pack notebook + library book for the waiting room. Mom will explain any new words after.

events.title: Ahmad - tablet time (queued playlist)
events.notes: Playlist set: 2 short clips (tide pools, desert beetles). Headphones in the cabinet. Timer on the oven for 20 min.

events.title: Library: pick out world atlas + cherry tree book
events.notes: Look in the travel shelf for the pink tree pages and the highland castle picture book. Renew the rock & mineral guide if still out.

events.title: Walmart — kid basics (size 6 pants, socks, sneakers)
events.notes: Plain colors, whatever's on the rack. No need to bring him in — last time he just wandered to the LEGO aisle. Match size from the tag on his current jeans.

events.title: Riverside Spring Safety Fair — Killgore Park
events.notes: Helmet fitting table with Officer Reyes again. Lions Club hot dogs at noon. Bring Ahmad's old helmet to swap. Coloring books and badge stickers at the kid table.

events.title: Quiet morning - Payette riverbank
events.notes: Sunday slow morning. Bring scrapbook and the rock bag. Pack the cucumber roll leftovers.

events.title: Pediatrician follow-up — Ahmad
events.notes: One child to check in. Bring notebook so he can draw while we wait. Dad picking up from work at 5:50.

events.title: Chore chart — put away LEGO bins, set napkins
events.notes: Sticker if all 3 done: bins, napkins, shoes by the door. No screens until after.

events.title: Splash & Splash kids swim - bring small rock for cubby
events.notes: Echoey room is the hard part. Earplugs in side pocket of swim bag. Quiet table in lobby afterward; let him sit before the car. Skip the after-class group song if it is too loud.

events.title: Miss Honaker check-in (paper folder + extra time)
events.notes: Bring Ahmad's scrapbook page. Ask her to keep using the printed steps and to let him finish reading aloud at his own pace. Coach Marcy emailed that he settled in once she sat on the steps and explained each part before splashing.

events.title: Ahmad spring booster - 1 dose
events.notes: Nurse Kelly doing the shot. Bring scrapbook + animal drawing for waiting room. No prep needed, no take-home meds expected.

events.title: Bedroom door closed - quiet time
events.notes: Wooden case on the desk. Practice book page 4, hold the breath light, neighbors next door. Rock box stays on the floor while practicing.

events.title: Parents — bills, taxes folder, March utilities
events.notes: Dad pulled the gray folder from the office. Tax stuff and the utility autopay. Ahmad bedtime stories at 7:45 — Mom will step away for that. Do not let Ahmad see the spreadsheet.

events.title: Saturday walk at Killebrew Park
events.notes: bring small notebook, look for the pond ducks, no playground crowd at this time

events.title: Spring Kids Day at Payette County Fairgrounds
events.notes: Walk through the 4-H barn. Dad wants to show Ahmad the irrigation pump demo. Pack the rock-sorting tin in case there is a creek stop on the way home.

events.title: Snake River walk: rock hunt + scrapbook taping
events.notes: Bring the small cloth bag and the stripey one from the canyon shelf for comparing. Tape new finds into the scrapbook with Mom after dinner.

events.title: Thousand Springs waterfall trail day
events.location: Thousand Springs State Park, Ritter Island unit
events.notes: Pack the canvas bag, water bottles, and a plastic bag for any trash we find on the path. Quiet voices near the spring pool so the little ducks stay. Pocket notebook for sketching whatever Ahmad spots.

events.title: Library nature DVD pickup with Ahmad
events.notes: Holds: two short pond-life episodes (10 min each) and the beaver kit booklet. Ahmad picks which one to watch with Dad after lunch.

events.title: Open swim - shallow side only (avoid 1pm rush)
events.location: Fruitland Community Center, 500 N Whitley Dr
events.notes: Morning slot is calmer per Coach Renee. Cucumber-avocado rolls and grapes packed. Park walk after if weather holds.

events.title: Walk + green hats at Plaza Park
events.notes: long way through the trees first, then bleachers; snack bag in the truck

events.title: Library hold pickup: 'Foxes of the North Field' + 'My First Owl' (3 books)
events.location: Fruitland Public Library, front desk hold shelf
events.notes: Ms. Hollis pulled the foxes title from animal shelf. Two are short-chapter, one is picture format. Return prior haul before Tuesday.

events.title: Ahmad - 6-year well-child visit, Dr. Halverson
events.location: Treasure Valley Pediatrics, 1450 SW 4th Ave, Fruitland
events.notes: Mom drives. Bring vaccine card and the orange folder. Ahmad can pick one library book for the waiting room. Snack after at Big Apple.

events.title: Grocery run with Ahmad
events.notes: Persian cucumbers, ripe avocado, sushi rice refill, snack carrots, cherry tomatoes, the small natural peanut butter Ahmad likes. Tortillas and shredded cheese if the bag is low.

events.title: Drawing animals in the scrapbook
events.notes: Finish the fox page. Tape in the rabbit from last week.

events.title: Press leaves from yard walk, tape into scrapbook
events.notes: Use the paper sheets between heavy books. Rock box on the shelf needs the new gray ones added. Keep drawing pages clean.

events.title: Show Grandma the new pages + bridge build
events.notes: Pages from this week: green frog, three river rocks, beetle on a stem. Eli's bridge model on the side. Tape the pressed leaf from the library before she gets here.

events.title: Bedtime wind-down with Mom
events.notes: Library book chapter, then lined-up LEGO animals by color. Soft hum playlist on low. Slow breaths if covers feel scratchy.

events.title: Ahmad after-school - reading app + 1 short clip
events.notes: 10 min on the phonics app, then 1 clip from the approved nature playlist (under 7 min). Tablet returns to the top shelf after.

events.title: Ahmad — Payette Aquatic Center, beginner Tuesday group (week 5)
events.location: Payette Aquatic Center, 700 SW 3rd Ave, Payette
events.notes: Show Ahmad the schedule card Monday night so he sees Tuesday is the pool day. Towel, goggles, snack bar after. Home by 18:00 for dinner.

events.title: Sort notebook pages into sections
events.notes: Ant pages -> green tab. Leaf pages -> yellow tab. Rocks list -> blue tab. Missing page numbers go on the back.

events.title: School day - Mrs. Patterson's class
events.notes: Morning library cart visit. Show of hands on whether to keep the Friday extra reading block. Bring the leaf folder for science share.

events.title: Swim lesson - try one width with Coach Marisol
events.notes: Goal: float past the red line and try one short width if ready. If not ready that's okay too. Pack scrapbook to draw the pool fish tiles after. Hope to go a little farther than last time.

events.title: Grocery run + pick up Ahmad's spring jacket from Kohl's
events.location: WinCo Foods on N Whitley, then Kohl's at Karcher Mall
events.notes: Full list: milk, eggs, bread, rice, chicken thighs, the cucumbers Ahmad picks out. Then grab the lime-green jacket I had on hold, used the 30% off coupon. Card on file.

events.title: Add to Ahmad's July paper
events.notes: Add 'big rainforest LEGO set ($89)' and the frog habitat book under the toucan figure. Tell him we wrote them down so he doesn't have to remember. Pencil only — he likes erasing and reordering.
